name: Skimo vertical race prep 50
description: Race-pace climbs for short vertical races and skimo events: three 6-minute efforts and a final push.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy and smooth. Nose breathing, shoulders loose.

steps.name: Race-pace climb
steps.notes: RPE 8. Controlled; do not start too fast.

steps.name: Final push
steps.notes: RPE 9 for the last minute only.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Let the breathing settle; sip water.
